<subject>Re: Q4 investor conference follow up</subject>
<body>
Great idea.

My key points would be that (a) the LPs need to see disciplined deployment across mid-market and (b) focus on standardizing our portfolio reporting metrics [no more ad-hoc requests]. Two simple, easy to understand thoughts.

Also, I think that it's a mistake to use the term "large fund sizes". We don't want large funds. We want vehicles that match our target market segments and deliver strong returns.

Preston
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Jacobs, Brent
Sent: Friday, October 17, 2025 8:05 AM
To: Shields, Victoria; Anthony, Robert Sanders (IR); Andrews, Rose; Davis, Alan; Moreno, Gregory; Andrade, Preston; Burton, Alison
Subject: Q4 investor conference follow up

In the aftermath of the investor conference and following up on Gregory's successful LP meetings, we should be out messaging on the follow-up as well. Perhaps Alison, Victoria and I can come up with some thoughts on key talking points and send them around for comment. Sound OK?
</quoted>
